definition: Data Modelling Basics is a core concept in Data Analytics. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Data Modelling Basics is
theory.body: Data Modelling Basics describes the methods and patterns used within Data Analytics to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Data Modelling Basics is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Data Modelling Basics matters
theory.body: Without Data Modelling Basics, systems built with Data Analytics are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Data Modelling Basics works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Data Modelling Basics follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Data Modelling Basics.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Data Modelling Basics
theory.body: Data Modelling Basics offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
